mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we are looking at 65 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, and a beautiful waning gibbous moon is overhead.

The city has announced road surface treatment work from August 4th through the 7th starting on Lincoln Street, and don't forget the city also offers a 100 dollar rebate for installing high efficiency toilets to help conserve water.

There is plenty to do around town with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree.
In a notable call from this past week, on July 22, two juveniles were cited for operating their e-motos on Lincoln Street and received a warning for reckless driving.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and if you are looking ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Volcano.
